{{Top|leg}}
The '''LCC-33 Blaster Overcharge system''' was produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The LCC-33 temporarily increased the rate of fire for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] blasters while simultaneously increasing primary weapon recharge rate in order to compensate for the power draw.
